bridge_functions.name: Clock.Elapsed
bridge_functions.description: The running timer and the restart count, for the time proof

bridge_functions.name: Secret.Set
bridge_functions.description: Keep a short secret encrypted under an Android Keystore key

bridge_functions.name: Secret.Get
bridge_functions.description: Read a kept secret

bridge_functions.name: Secret.Delete
bridge_functions.description: Delete a kept secret

bridge_functions.name: Lock.Status
bridge_functions.description: Whether a fingerprint or face can be used

bridge_functions.name: Lock.Prompt
bridge_functions.description: Show the fingerprint / face prompt (answer: LockAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Location.Fix
bridge_functions.description: One fresh location reading with a time limit (answer: LocationAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Camera.Take
bridge_functions.description: Take a selfie with the face outline or a back photo, made small (answer: CameraAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Qr.Scan
bridge_functions.description: Scan a QR code with CameraX and ZXing (answer: QrAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Push.Permission
bridge_functions.description: Ask to show notices (answer: PushPermissionAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Push.Token
bridge_functions.description: The Firebase token of this phone (answer: PushTokenAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Push.Opened
bridge_functions.description: The address of the tapped notice, once

bridge_functions.name: Push.Labels
bridge_functions.description: The app's texts of the buttons a push may ask for (e.g. {"crm.call": "Call"}); a button without one is not shown

bridge_functions.name: Sync.Schedule
bridge_functions.description: Send what waits with WorkManager when online, also with the app closed

bridge_functions.name: Sync.Cancel
bridge_functions.description: Stop the background sends

bridge_functions.name: Update.Install
bridge_functions.description: Download an APK, check its SHA-256 and open the installer (answer: UpdateAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Window.Clear
bridge_functions.description: Remove the cloud window cookies, page storage and cache

bridge_functions.name: Print.Receipt
bridge_functions.description: Print a receipt page (or a PNG) as an ESC/POS picture over Bluetooth, USB or the network; off unless features.print (answer: PrintAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Print.Printers
bridge_functions.description: The paired Bluetooth printers and the attached USB printers; off unless features.print

bridge_functions.name: Print.Drawer
bridge_functions.description: Open the cash drawer through the receipt printer (ESC p); off unless features.print (answer: PrintAnswered)

bridge_functions.name: Scan.Keys
bridge_functions.description: Catch a scanner that types while no field has the cursor, on or off; off unless features.scan_keys (codes: ScanReceived)

bridge_functions.name: Scan.Camera
bridge_functions.description: Read product barcodes and QR codes with the back camera, one or many in a row; off unless features.scan_camera (codes: ScanReceived, end: ScanCameraClosed)

bridge_functions.name: Scan.Answer
bridge_functions.description: One line (ok, warn, error) under the aim box of the open camera scan screen for 2 s; off unless features.scan_camera

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Send
bridge_functions.description: One SMS from a SIM slot (multipart for a long or Bangla text); outcome as SmsAnswered; off unless features.sms_send

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Sims
bridge_functions.description: The phone's SIMs (slot, operator label; Android gives no SIM number); off unless features.sms_send

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Permission
bridge_functions.description: Android's SEND_SMS and READ_PHONE_STATE question; answer as SmsPermissionAnswered; off unless features.sms_send

bridge_functions.name: Messages.Start
bridge_functions.description: Keep the device key (Keystore vault) and the office address, start the background job that sends the business's SMS; off unless features.sms_send

bridge_functions.name: Messages.Work
bridge_functions.description: Wake the background SMS job now; off unless features.sms_send

bridge_functions.name: Messages.Stop
bridge_functions.description: Stop the background SMS job and forget its key, settings and counts

bridge_functions.name: Messages.Status
bridge_functions.description: What the phone knows now: online, can_send, the SIM service, sent and failed today; off unless features.sms_send

bridge_functions.name: Notice.Schedule
bridge_functions.description: Show a timed notice at its minute by itself (also offline, app closed, after a restart), with Call and Later; off unless features.notice_schedule

bridge_functions.name: Notice.Cancel
bridge_functions.description: Take away one timed notice (id) or all of a group (group); off unless features.notice_schedule

bridge_functions.name: Notice.Opened
bridge_functions.description: What the tapped timed notice opens (open, open_id, action open|call), once (also sent as NoticeOpened)

bridge_functions.name: Calls.Recent
bridge_functions.description: The work calls of the call list after the last read: only calls whose number ends in one of the app's compare keys; off unless features.calls_recent

bridge_functions.name: Calls.Ended
bridge_functions.description: Wake the app's background command a few seconds after a call ends, also with the app closed (on / off); off unless features.calls_ended

bridge_functions.name: Calls.Permission
bridge_functions.description: Android's READ_CALL_LOG / READ_PHONE_STATE question for the switched-on call jobs; answer as CallsPermissionAnswered

bridge_functions.name: Calls.Status
bridge_functions.description: The call jobs' switches, their permissions and whether the end of a call wakes the app

bridge_functions.name: Calls.Folder
bridge_functions.description: Android's folder chooser for the phone's call recordings folder (read grant of that folder only, kept), or forget it; answer as CallsFolderAnswered; off unless features.calls_recording

bridge_functions.name: Calls.FolderStatus
bridge_functions.description: Whether call recordings are switched on and a recordings folder is chosen (its name)

bridge_functions.name: Calls.Recording
bridge_functions.description: One saved work call's recording found in the chosen folder, copied app-private (AAC re-wrapped as .mp4) with its size and SHA-256; off unless features.calls_recording

bridge_functions.name: Calls.RecordingDrop
bridge_functions.description: Remove the app's copy of a call's recording
